source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique OOB single-entry delete; Clear SEL is not equivalent.

source_snapshot.procedure: Raw 0x0A/0x46 with no reservation or record ID; surrounding log clear.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; needs exact raw bytes/entry; warns irreversible delete.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes missing entry ID but omits reservation, export and no-unrelated-entry proof.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Requires exact two-byte reservation/record IDs, immutable export and one irreversible targeted delete.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Missing approved target record is readiness; broad/ambiguous deletion must fail closed.

original_test_intent: Delete exactly one owner-approved SEL record and prove no other repository entry changed.
original_method: Use Storage 0x0A/0x46 with a valid reservation ID and exact two-byte record ID.
manual_activity: Repository owner selects one disposable record, approves irreversible loss and reviews the pre/post inventory.
agent_execution_scope: Delete once only if separately authorized
Read back repository and compare every unrelated entry

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly withholds a runnable command but does not define the reservation/export/delta contract.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After explicit approval use protected raw 0x0A/0x46 <reservation_lo> <reservation_hi> <record_lo> <record_hi> exactly once.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source no-data command, Script and timing remain preserved as source evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Export/hash SEL, delete one approved ID, then prove only that ID disappeared; retain evidence because restore is not guaranteed.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds mandatory request bytes and irreversible-operation controls without changing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Completion alone cannot prove which record was deleted or that neighbors survived.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong identity destroys audit, incident or warranty evidence with no reliable restore.

project_override_considerations: A vendor delete API is equivalent only when it targets the same immutable identity and provides complete before/after repository evidence; Clear SEL is never equivalent.
expected_evidence: Pre/post record counts and neighbor comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title names single-entry deletion, but the preserved Procedure omits both mandatory reservation and record ID, so the shown command cannot perform the stated operation safely.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Standard semantics are identifiable; exact record, reservation and approval are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents an incomplete irreversible command and makes exact-target deletion and collateral-integrity evidence mandatory.
independent_technical_reasoning: A SEL delete has no dependable undo. The selected record must be bound to a pre-delete export and two-byte ID, while the post-delete comparison verifies the target vanished and every unrelated record remained byte-identical; an uncertain completion must never be retried.
